programmes.d: Revengeful night riders from Missouri invade Dodge City and challenge the authority of deputy Festus Haggen.
Matt and Chester track down a horse thief.
Marshal Dillon is forced to send to prison a man he believes innocent of the crime for which he will be hanged. (TV-PG)
When an old friend of Doc Adams is suspected of being a thief, Doc takes it upon himself to bring the man to justice.
Newly's best friend becomes the victim of a con game perpetrated by a pretty young girl and her partner.
Matt reluctantly arrests Chester for murder.
A new Long Branch Saloon hostess becomes the innocent victim of a dispute between two jealous cowboys.
A childhood friend of Festus kills a prospector and then loses his mind when he finds the apparently rich mine contains only fool's gold.
Marshal Dillon is caught in the middle when feuding cattle lords bring their struggle for power to Dodge City.
Kitty, en route from Owl Flats to Dodge City by buckboard, is kidnapped by Apache war priest Gregorio, an escaped cavalry prisoner.
One of the drifters who killed a man's dog is found dead.
An old woman grieving over the loss of her outlaw son tries to help another young outlaw escape justice. Boot Hill Intro returns for this episode and appears intermittently hereafter.
A woman comes a long way from the east to Dodge, only to realize that her fiancé has lost all his money and does not wish to marry her.
Matt Dillon runs into an old flame when he rides into an outlaw hideout.
Angry homesteaders protest headstrong Susan Bart's plan to divert a creek on her ranch, cutting off their water supply.
A bizarre attempted robbery by two bumbling hill country brothers turns into a comedy of errors before it is finally thwarted by Festus who is acting as Matt's deputy.
A woman claims to have killed her outlaw son to prevent him from turning himself in.
Matt is forced to kill a man for resisting arrest, only to incur the wrath of the man's family.
Kitty's conscience is torn between her sense of obligation to a man who saved her life and her concern for the law and Matt Dillon.
Mannon, a ruthless, fast-draw gunman shoots Festus, steals his mule, and terrorizes Dodge City.
A young man's seemingly harmless desire to look for a job in Dodge City results in tragedy. (TV-PG)

A robber holds up a stagecoach carrying Matt, then turns up in Dodge.
A sequence of tragedies leads to the death of three cowboys, one of them an old friend of Matt's.
After Marshal Dillon is forced to kill a crooked gambler, his vengeful father sets out to kill the marshal
Marshal Dillon learns that an old friend has become deranged and is bent on driving ranchers off their land with his gun.
Newly's skill with both people and medicine is put to the test when Doc sends him out to check on families in the back country
A young fanner's ex-partner in crime, his girlfriend, and his slow-witted brother figure in the discovery of his forgotten past.
